articles.title: The White House's crypto chief departs: State of Crypto
articles.summary: Patrick Witt announced his departure from the White House last week.

articles.title: Wall Street freaked out Friday. VIX and bitcoin say the fear may fade Monday.
articles.summary: Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index, spiked on Friday as stocks dropped. History says Friday panics usually fade on Monday. Seasonality and calm bitcoin suggest the same.

articles.title: Latvia eyes crypto tax payments in 2027 as parliament overhauls crypto taxation
articles.summary: Parliament passed a law taxing crypto withdrawals above deposits rather than individual trades, featuring a one-time declaration mechanism.
